journey.name: pin attempts wipe gate
journey.description:
Verifies that running out of PIN attempts wipes the wallet behind a gate that a relaunch cannot get past: once the last attempt fails, no PIN pad or biometric prompt is shown until the wipe has finished, and a relaunch resumes the wipe instead of offering the PIN again.
Precondition: a disposable, unfunded dev wallet with the app PIN enabled (Settings > Security) and a known PIN, biometrics off, on the PIN pad after a relaunch. This deletes the wallet. Force-stopping the app while the gate shows only lands on a step if the wipe is still running. Killing it at each wipe step on a real device stays a manual check.

actions.action: Verify the PIN pad is visible (testTag "PinPad")
Enter a wrong PIN with the number pad keys (testTags "N0" to "N9") until the last-attempt message (testTag "LastAttempt") is visible
Enter a wrong PIN once more
Verify the wipe gate is visible (testTag "WipeGate") and the PIN pad (testTag "PinPad") is not
Run adb shell am force-stop to.bitkit.dev, then adb shell am start -n to.bitkit.dev/to.bitkit.ui.MainActivity
Verify either the wipe gate (testTag "WipeGate") or wallet onboarding is visible, and the PIN pad (testTag "PinPad") is not
Wait for the wipe to finish and verify wallet onboarding is visible
